sanskrit_verse: अनावेद्य तु यो राज्ञे संदिग्धे ऽर्थे प्रवर्तते । प्रसह्य स विनेयः स्यात् स चास्यार्थो न सिध्यति ॥
transliteration: anāvedya tu yo rājñe saṃdigdhe 'rthe pravartate | prasahya sa vineyaḥ syāt sa cāsyārtho na sidhyati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who acts before informing the King regarding a doubtful matter shall be restrained by force; moreover, his purpose will not succeed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sovereign awareness of the Rajarshi
Causation arises from alignment with rightful knowledge-transfer
Capacity-based responsibility requires prior disclosure in uncertain affairs
Restoration logic mandates obstruction of misaligned action until realignment
Consciousness alignment necessitates transparency before executive engagement
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent initiates action without informing the sovereign on a disputed issue THEN system must halt and restrain the action automatically
IF action proceeds without rajasic consent in ambiguous context THEN outcome validity is nullified by default
IF disclosure is absent in contested domain THEN no enforceable consequence shall accrue to the ruler
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any executive or judicial actor initiating process without presenting preliminary doubt to the presiding sovereign-aware authority renders that proceeding invalid and subject to immediate cessation. The court must ensure full transparency protocols precede discretionary interventions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that unreported action in uncertainty disrupts dharma-sambandha. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows such disruption leads to failure of intent. Responsibility lies in restoring communication flow, not inflicting penalty. Truthful sequence reveals obstruction was self-imposed due to omission.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Mandatory completion of retroactive reporting to sovereign-aware authority
Reintegration through acknowledgment of disrupted causal alignment
Temporary suspension of operational capacity until transparency protocol is fulfilled
Instructional restoration of correct procedural sequencing
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed: action unannounced in doubt fails by its own divergence. Thus, consciousness is restored, authority upheld, and reality remains non-punitive.
